
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/uoky/p/21664355" title="发布于 2026-07-20 09:01">
    
        <img src="/images/aigc-marker.svg" class="text-front-icon" title="本文内容由AI生成" alt="AIGC标识">

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">开源项目自荐：OpenCode Session Viewer</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">

<div class="opencode-intro">
<div class="hero">
<div class="logo">📊</div>
<h1>OpenCode Session Viewer</h1>
<p class="subtitle">浏览 OpenCode 全部会话历史的轻量 Web 工具，支持分页与用户输入回溯</p>
<p class="subtitle">最新版新增：会话导出功能，将某次会话导出为json（因未更新示例图片，需自行clone项目查看效果）</p>
<div class="badge-row"><span class="badge badge-green">🐍 零依赖</span> <span class="badge badge-blue">⚡ 即开即用</span> <span class="badge badge-purple">🌙 明/暗主题</span></div>
</div>
<h2 class="section-title">✨ 功能特性</h2>
<div class="feature-grid">
<div class="feature-card">
<div class="icon">📋</div>
<div class="title">会话浏览</div>
<p class="desc">按创建时间浏览所有 session，支持分页（10 / 20 / 50 条/页），轻松翻阅历史记录。</p>
</div>
<div class="feature-card">
<div class="icon">💬</div>
<div class="title">用户输入回溯</div>
<p class="desc">展开任意 session 查看最近 10 次用户输入，快速定位关键对话节点。</p>
</div>
<div class="feature-card">
<div class="icon">💰</div>
<div class="title">用量 &amp; 成本信息</div>
<p class="desc">展示 token 用量、预估成本、Agent 类型、Model 等元信息，消费一目了然。</p>
</div>
<div class="feature-card">
<div class="icon">⚡</div>
<div class="title">零依赖纯标准库</div>
<p class="desc">后端仅使用 Python 3 标准库（http.server + sqlite3），无需 pip install 任何包。</p>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="section-title">🚀 快速开始</h2>
<div class="code-block"><span class="comment"># 方式一：双击 start.bat（Windows）</span> <span class="cmd">start.bat</span></div>
<div class="code-block"><span class="comment"># 方式二：命令行启动（自动打开浏览器）</span></div>
<div class="code-block"><span class="cmd">python</span> <span class="arg">server.py</span></div>
<div class="code-block"><span class="comment"># 指定端口和数据库路径</span></div>
<div class="code-block"><span class="cmd">python</span> <span class="arg">server.py</span> <span class="cmd">--port</span> <span class="arg">8765</span> <span class="cmd">--db</span> <span class="arg">"C:\path\to\opencode.db"</span></div>
<p style="color: rgba(107, 114, 128, 1); font-size: 14px">📌 浏览器会自动打开，无需手动操作。</p>
<h2 class="section-title">🗄️ 数据库路径</h2>
<p>默认读取 OpenCode 的 SQLite 数据库：</p>
<div class="path-box"> 默认路径：<code>%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\opencode\opencode.db</code><br>
  也可通过环境变量 <code>OPENCODE_DB</code> 自定义覆盖。
</div>
<h2 class="section-title">🛠️ 技术栈</h2>
<div class="tech-stack">
<div class="tech-item">
     <strong>后端：</strong>Python 3 + http.server + sqlite3（全标准库）
  </div>
<div class="tech-item">
     <strong>前端：</strong>原生 HTML / CSS / JS，暗色/明亮主题
  </div>






</div>
